title: Output Aggregation Values
description: Measure shapes accepted by the output param. Canonical source is the aggregation enum in libs-server/validators.mjs and the plugin registrations in libs-server/data-views/output-aggregator-registry.mjs.

rate.description: Divides the summed measure by the count of periods

count.description: Counts the periods whose aggregated measure total satisfies the threshold predicate
count.note: The threshold applies to the per-period aggregate, not to individual source rows — a 100-yard-game count filters on the game's summed yards.

implicit_default.description: Omitting the output param entirely means a plain SUM over the column's measure with no period grain. 'sum' is not a valid value of the aggregation field; it is the behavior when the field is absent, and it bypasses the aggregator registry.

validation_errors.outputCountRequiresThreshold: aggregation 'count' supplied without a threshold object
validation_errors.outputThresholdRequiresCount: threshold supplied with an aggregation other than 'count'
validation_errors.no_output_aggregator: the (period, aggregation) pair has no registered plugin
